services.name: Fishing Types
services.desc: You’ll be fishing aboard the “Fish Assassin,” a 24’ Blazer Bay center console boat. The boat runs on a 250 HP Yamaha 4-stroke engine, and it’s the perfect vessel for small groups and family trips. The bow of the boat is equipped with an I-pilot trolling motor for shallow waters. The Fish Assassin has all the gear to stay on course and to have a trip to remember! (1-3 people) (4th person +$50)Looking for a well-rounded fishing experience? Our 6-hour trips are a great choice for anglers of all levels. We kick off the morning with light tackle inshore fishing, targeting popular species like speckled trout, redfish, flounder, and sheepshead. As the day progresses, we often transition into

blurb: Guests fish near the Mississippi barrier islands targeting species like speckled trout, redfish, sheepshead, flounder, bull redfish, sharks, jack crevalle, tripletail, and cobia. Trips include rods, reels, tackle, lures, catch cleaning and filleting. The boat seats up to 4 people and offers amenities like fishfinder, wireless trolling motor, GPS, live bait, and tackle.

quotes.text: Captain Brian is a patient man! With 4 inexperienced fisherman he taught us skills and techniques! He even caught fish for us to take home. The boat was spotless, and had lots of storage for all our belongings. We had a great time! We will be booking again with him!

Brian made this a great experience, we had a blast! He did an excellent job communicating with us before the trip so we knew exactly what to expect . He was very professional and had great equipment. Will definitely use him again next time we are in the area.
We had a great time and caught large red fish and trout. Captain Brian provided everything we needed including taking us to find shark. Would recommend to anyone wanting a charter with a nice guide.​
